decisions.reason: The thermal inkjet printer sits close to the core coding portfolio and has its own web page, so the firm's visible commitment and its surface-matched, single-source strategy favor keeping it.
The in-house piezo inkjet printer is publicly featured and central to the technology-matching offer, so sunk development costs and the need to justify the launch argue for persistence.

As a multi-model flagship line shown on the home page and tied to the announced Industry 4.0 direction, the laser marking systems carry the strongest public commitment, so any weak results would be read as temporary.

The compact laser cabin was publicly announced as new and fits the laser strategy, but since a similar enclosed workstation was already withdrawn it carries somewhat higher risk, though the recent launch still calls for persistence.

The award-winning lubricant printing system has public validation from the trade fair award, and it extends the firm's high-resolution inkjet competence into a niche, which management would want to justify by persisting.
